note: Put your AdSense publisher id here (the ca-pub-… string) once the account is approved. While it is empty no ad code is emitted at all, and the planner never carries ads either way - it has to keep working offline.
_comment: Advertising config. Kept out of buildables.json because that file is inlined wholesale into the offline planner, and the planner neither shows ads nor should ship a publisher id. Clearing publisherId removes all ad code and deletes docs/ads.txt.
